ios.desc:
The Grateful Jar is the place where you keep a record of each one of your grateful moments in a few words.

Make the most out of it by writing about small and big things you are grateful for. The app makes it easy to do it on the stop, when it happens.

Whenever you are feeling a bit down or not motivated, recall the moments you were grateful in the past for a quick boost of positive moments from the past.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Grateful Jar. A journal to collect and recall grateful moments

quotes.text:
Since the beginning of the yearI have been playing around with Swift & SwiftUI and never finished a project so I decided to build this gratitude journal over the weekend and launch it.

All your entries are kept on your phone and synced with your iCloud.

Enjoy!
